canonical_name: Native Density / UCM Readout Discrimination Witness

controlled_pair.visible_state: u_vis omits that hidden organization under the declared ordinary S2 reconstruction
known_distinctions: Delta rho_H > 0 under the conditional witness assumptions

two_probe_gate.question: Does Pi_U(u_full) != Pi_U(u_vis) for the controlled pair?
two_probe_gate.status: OPEN; listing A/Rred/B as inputs does not prove nonconstancy.

failure_condition: Both probes are shown to identify/annihilate the controlled full-vs-visible distinction on the declared domain.
